## PB-01: the Sharadar subscription (fail)
**The S&P 500 membership history can't support DATA-02 or LOAD-01 as your plan delivers it.** This doesn't depend on my scripts: Sharadar's own count says the whole S&P 500 file is about 1,000 rows.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| C3 | fail: the history starts in 2007-01, not 2000. Actions come as `added`, `removed`, `current` and `historical` |
| C4 | fail: 78 of 1,006 (ticker, date) pairs map to a `permaticker`; there are 39 stocks in all |
| C5 | fail: 29–36 members at every month-end, against 495–510 |
| C6 | fail: 7 of your 10 names end within 3 days of your dates (6 exactly). Merrill Lynch (MER) and Wyeth (WYE) aren't in the table. Kodak (EK) left the index 395 days before it was delisted |
| C7–C9 | fail: the full price file came back empty (0 rows), although Sharadar lists about 5.1 million rows and 490 MB for it. Nothing was timed, priced or checked |
| C2 | fail by the script, but that's my bug: all four tables answer. The tickers file has about 40 rows, which my rounding to thousands turned into 0 |
| C1 | pass: your key is from sharadar.com. The plan page wasn't checked, and C2 shows all four tables answer |

I'm overriding the script on C7: it reported pass, but an empty download timed nothing, so I recorded fail.

The price table itself looks full-size; only the download came back empty. That may be my download code: it didn't record the file's ready status, so I can't tell whether the file was still being prepared. So prices aren't proven either way.

## PB-02: Yahoo through yahooquery (fail)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| C1 | fail: 31 of 503 current members came back. The other 472 were dropped with no error, and all 20 I spot-checked got HTTP 429 (too many requests) from your connection as well as mine |
| C2 | pass on its wording, but all 5 delisted test symbols were silently missing with 429, so delisted can't be told apart from throttled |
| C3 | fail: run time can't be measured while requests are throttled |
| C4 | pass with a note: 34 of 39 came back, 3 of them delisted. The 5 missing all got 429. 39 symbols say nothing about the 1,100 that QR-03's time limit covers |
| C5 | fail: 0 stocks compared, because PB-01's price file was empty |

DATA-05 needs 95% of current members, and Yahoo returned 6%.

## Hand-offs
- **architecture-design Revise, AD-03:** your plan's S&P 500 table starts in 2007 with about 40 stocks, so it can't give membership since 2000 (DATA-02, LOAD-01). The options are a plan that includes the full table, which costs extra and runs into QR-02, or another source for membership. AD-03's route also still needs fixing (`api.sharadar.com`, not Nasdaq Data Link). If prices stay with Sharadar, PB-01 needs a revision to find out why the full download came back empty.
- **architecture-design Revise, AD-04:** yahooquery is throttled to 6% coverage, and it drops symbols silently. Options include slower batches with backoff, another free source, or a different client.
- **spec-writing, only if you say so:** LOAD-06 compares each name's index exit date with your list, but your list holds delisting dates, and for Kodak the two are 395 days apart. Either the list's dates are checked against the last trading day (DATA-04), or LOAD-06 changes. If architecture-design finds no affordable source for membership since 2000, DATA-02 goes to spec-writing too.

## Open question
**Can you ask Sharadar whether your plan includes the full S&P 500 table?** My guess is that it's a limited tier for that table. If it isn't, the 2007 start may be Sharadar's problem rather than your plan's.

Do you approve recording both probes as `Answered · fail · 2026-10-18`? A yes commits `docs/probes.md`, and architecture-design Revise comes next.
